create.name: Stacia Butterfield
create.bio:
Stacia Butterfield facilitates Holotropic Breathwork, the method of deep, rhythmic breathing and evocative music developed by Stanislav and Christina Grof to open non-ordinary states of consciousness. After training as a somatic practitioner in the late 1990s, she certified as a facilitator in 2005 and spent well over a decade on the staff of Grof Transpersonal Training, working beside Grof himself and helping to run residential trainings and large public workshops in universities, conference halls and retreat centres.

Her groups follow the classic format: participants pair up and take turns as breather and sitter, then draw, move and talk through whatever came up. She has also brought this experiential work into professional settings, among them programmes for people preparing to work in psychedelic-assisted therapy. Alongside breathwork she draws on myth, story, writing and ritual, an interest shaped by years of study with the author Clarissa Pinkola Estés. She leads week-long programmes at Esalen in Big Sur several times a year, as well as one-day workshops in Oakland and occasional retreats elsewhere in the United States.

courses.title: Holotropic Breathwork: Expanded States of Consciousness (November 2026)
courses.description: A five-day residential workshop at Esalen in Big Sur built around four Holotropic Breathwork sessions, two as breather and two as sitter. Contemplative practice, movement, expressive arts and group sharing help participants prepare for and make sense of the experience. Newcomers and experienced breathers are both welcome.

courses.title: Holotropic Breathwork: Expanded States of Consciousness (February 2027)
courses.description: The same week-long Holotropic Breathwork programme, held again at Esalen in late February. Each person breathes twice and sits for a partner twice, with movement, art and reflection woven through the week.
